title: PlayerCompassMOD
description: This mod helps you track nearby players in a simple and customizable way.
body:
This mod helps you track nearby players in a simple and customizable way.

It displays player information on your screen and allows you to adjust how it looks and behaves.

Features:
- Toggle the display on/off
- Customize tracking range and maximum players shown
- Move and scale the display
- Optional background and transparency settings
- Simple commands for easy control

Commands:
/pcm → Open settings overview
/pcm toggle → Enable/disable the mod
/pcm range <number> → Set tracking range
/pcm max <number> → Set maximum displayed players
/pcm move <x> <y> → Move the display position
/pcm scale <value> → Adjust display size
/pcm bg → Toggle background
/pcm bga <0-10> → Adjust background transparency
/team  team mode


This mod is designed for general gameplay use and does not modify server behavior.
